title: Invest or Protect: A study on awareness about Mutual Funds in Generation Z
abstract: An empirical inquiry into financial literacy, risk perception, and investment awareness regarding Mutual Funds among Generation Z consumers.

title: Shaping Leaders or Followers: Role of Educational Institutions in Modeling Generation Z Women as Entrepreneurs
abstract: Investigating how higher educational institutions curate entrepreneurial mindsets, leadership capabilities, and self-efficacy in Generation Z women entrepreneurs.

title: TRENDS ON SOCIAL MEDIA: Corollary of Social Media and Technology post NEP 2020
abstract: Examines the interrelationship between social media trends, educational technology adoption, and policy implications following the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 in India.

title: Leveraging AI for Personalized Marketing in E-Commerce: Strategies, Benefits, and Challenges
venue: Journal of Digital Commerce & AI Strategies
abstract: Analyzes algorithmic machine learning techniques utilized for hyper-personalized marketing in e-commerce platforms, outlining strategic advantages and operational implementation challenges.

title: Friends or Foes: Role of Conversational Interfaces in Customer Engagement on Swiggy
venue: International Journal of Consumer Research & Digital Platforms
abstract: Investigating conversational AI interfaces and food delivery customer touchpoints on Swiggy, measuring user satisfaction, responsiveness, and platform retention.

title: Gamification in Mobile Apps: Assessing the Effects on Customer Engagement and Loyalty in the Retail Industry
abstract: Evaluates how gamified app elements influence user retention, repeat purchase behavior, and brand loyalty across mobile retail applications.

title: Balancing Personalization and Privacy: Safeguarding Data in AI-Enabled Targeted Marketing
venue: Journal of AI Ethics & Marketing Governance
abstract: Addresses the tension between consumer desire for customized online shopping and increasing privacy concerns regarding AI data harvesting in targeted marketing.

title: The Role and Impact of Voice Assistants in Online Shopping: User Preferences, Challenges, and Opportunities
abstract: Assesses voice-activated shopping platforms, evaluating user preference patterns, speech recognition accuracy challenges, and future opportunities in voice commerce.

title: Transforming Shopping: Use of Augmented Reality To Enhance Customer Experience
abstract: Explores virtual try-on and 3D spatial product visualizations, demonstrating how augmented reality reduces pre-purchase uncertainty and enhances customer satisfaction.
